definition.en: The sequence of development and reproduction linking living things with their next generation. A cycle diagram includes more than one individual.
definition.zh: 生物发育并繁殖、连接到下一代的过程。生活史环图包含的不只是同一个体。

definition.en: A reproductive structure from which a young animal can develop after fertilisation under suitable conditions. A chicken egg has a shell; the frog eggs here have jelly coats.
definition.zh: 动物的繁殖结构，受精并处在适宜条件下，幼体可以在其中发育。鸡卵外有壳；这里的蛙卵外有胶质包被。

definition.en: The free-swimming young frog in this example, with a tail and a body form very different from an adult frog. It is a frog larva, not a fish.
definition.zh: 这个例子里能自由游泳的青蛙幼体，有尾巴，形态与成蛙很不相同。它是青蛙的幼体，不是鱼。

definition.en: A young frog with the frog body form and limbs. Part of its tail may remain while the tail is being absorbed.
definition.zh: 身体已呈蛙形、长出四肢的幼小青蛙。尾巴在被吸收的过程中，可能还有一段留在身体上。

definition.en: A mature individual that has reached the reproductive stage of its life cycle. The adult chicken shown here is a hen.
definition.zh: 已经成熟、进入能够繁殖的生命阶段的个体。这里画的成鸡是一只母鸡。

definition.en: A young chicken. It grows into an adult chicken; it does not pass through a pupa.
definition.zh: 幼小的鸡。它生长成为成鸡，不经过蛹期。

definition.en: A developing young animal before it hatches. In the chicken egg model it is drawn separately from the yolk.
definition.zh: 孵出前正在发育的动物幼体。鸡卵模型把它与卵黄分开画。

definition.en: The part of the egg that supplies nourishment for the developing embryo. It is not itself a miniature chick.
definition.zh: 卵内为发育中的胚胎提供营养的部分。它本身不是一只缩小的雏鸡。

definition.en: The young animal coming out of its egg. Development has already begun inside the egg before hatching.
definition.zh: 动物幼体从卵中出来。孵出以前，幼体已经在卵内开始发育。

definition.en: The joining of male and female reproductive cells. A chicken egg must be fertilised before a chick can develop; suitable incubation is also needed.
definition.zh: 雄性与雌性生殖细胞结合。鸡卵必须先受精，才可能发育出雏鸡；还需要适宜的孵化条件。

definition.en: Producing offspring, the next generation. An adult-to-egg arrow means reproduction, not an adult becoming an egg again.
definition.zh: 产生后代，也就是下一代。成体通向卵的箭头表示繁殖，不是成体变回卵。

definition.en: Development involving a marked change between the body forms of a young animal and its adult. A frog can undergo metamorphosis without a pupa.
definition.zh: 幼体与成体的身体形态发生明显变化的发育过程。青蛙的变态发育不经过蛹期。

definition.en: The stage between larva and adult in the mosquito life cycle. There is no pupa in the frog or chicken sequences shown here.
definition.zh: 蚊子的生活史中，位于幼虫和成虫之间的阶段。这里的青蛙与鸡都没有蛹期。

definition.en: A young plant that has developed from a seed. It can grow into an adult plant; it is not an animal larva.
definition.zh: 由种子发育出来的幼小植物，可以继续长成成株。它不是动物的幼虫。
